title: Stopped working after a few months
text: Stopped working after a few months. Everything was going great and I loved it! But suddenly it stopped working after a few months. I tried 2 brand new canisters and both times the water came out flat. It no longer makes the loud noise like it used to, its almost like it lost all its power. I don't have an option in Amazon to contact the seller so hopefully a review gets their attention!
